notes:
This app enables the Sensor Tile.boxPRO to measure ECG signals using the DIL24 biosensor evaluation kit STEVAL-MKI250KA (ST1VAFE3BX). By activating this Flow, you can view the ECG signal and key parameters with the Medical Signal Demo, as well as the time progression of the heartbeat with the Heart Rate Demo.
nTo obtain valid data, place two fingers from different hands on the exposed electrodes, ensuring the loop is closed around the heart to read its electrical potential. Make sure your hands do not touch each other and avoid applying excessive pressure on the electrodes, as muscle shaking can interfere with accurate measurements. For optimal results, unplug the board to minimize power line interference. The electrodes are made of tinned copper, and continuous usage can create a dirty film. Be sure to clean the electrodes before demonstration testing, preferably with an alcohol solution.
nThe measured data is processed using the BioVSM library embedded in the Sensor Tile.box MCU, which detects peaks and computes key parameters such as average, maximum, and minimum heart rate. Check the library documentation for more details.
